'''Master Sanche''' was a fisherman from the [[Tear (city)|City of Tear]]. He was the father of [[Siuan Sanche]].
==History==
Master Sanche had a profound upbringing on his daughter, a fisher girl named Siuan, who adopted many of his characteristics. His wife passed away when his daughter was still young.

After it was found that Siuan possessed the [[spark]], she was sent to the [[White Tower]] to train as a novice. Master Sanche died while his daughter was still training at the Tower.{{ref/book|0|2}} His daughter eventually rose to become the [[Amyrlin Seat]].

== In the television series ==
In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], {{TVlink|Berden Sanche}} is played by {{TVlink|Peter de Jersey}}.
